name: Distorted Time shortens Timerend's cooldown and lengthens Decomposition (#982)
contract: Distorted Time 707553's tooltip reads "Reduces the cooldown of Timerend by $/1000;s2 sec and increases the duration of Decomposition by $/1000;s1 sec". In Spell.dbc both effects are SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107): Effect[0] EffectMiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), EffectBasePoints 2999 + DieSides 1 = +3000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask [0,524288,0], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects Decomposition (800856, 801028-801033, 802597); Effect[1] EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -2001 + DieSides 1 = -2000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask [0,16777216,0], which selects Timerend (501831-501835, 572578, 801291). Timerend carries CategoryRecoveryTime 20000 and Decomposition DurationIndex 86; neither has SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod admits both modifiers. Aura::CalcMaxDuration consumes SPELLMOD_DURATION (SpellAuras.cpp) and Player::ApplySpellMod applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime (Player.cpp). Generic core machinery. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works. The client renders $/1000;s2 as -2, so the shipped tooltip says "by -2 sec"; that is a text artefact, not a server defect.
